description: Codex: Orks (11e) ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN (War Horde) in the ENEMY's Fight phase through the real enemy_targets_unit_fight window, and the 05.04.05 Fight On Death mechanic it shares with TOO ARROGANT TO DIE / CRAZED RAMPAGE. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes ACTIVE, P2 Orks (War Horde) non-active; Custodian Guard A engaged with Boyz B (+ attached Warboss). Setup-only privileges: Custodian Guard A gets Fights First during the Custodes' Charge phase so the Custodes pick first; the Boyz are riled up (Waaagh! flag) to show the +1; auto wound allocation for the Ork defender; Custodian Guard A's wounds inflated so it survives the swing back. The Custodes player clicks Custodian Guard A in the picker, picks a Ka'tah stance, assigns all attacks to the Boyz and confirms: the window opens for PLAYER 2 (the targeted unit's owner) BEFORE any dice are rolled; the StratagemDialog shows ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN with an enabled Use button. A real click on Use spends P2's CP and resumes the held attack roll; every Boyz model destroyed rolls a D6+1 (game log + dice log), models on a 4+ stay on the battlefield (alive, 0 wounds, pending), the Boyz then fight with them, and they are removed once the Boyz have fought.
